simulate.title: Simulation
simulate.subtitle: Closed-loop vehicle dynamics: trajectory, controllers, actuators and vehicle model.
simulate.modelTip: Kinematic: no tire slip. Linear/nonlinear single track: lateral dynamics. Double track: roll and wheel spin. Multibody: heave, pitch, unsprung masses. Neural: trained surrogate.
simulate.lateralTip: Steers the vehicle along the reference path.
simulate.muTip: 1.0 dry asphalt, about 0.5 wet, about 0.2 snow.
simulate.solverTip: RK4 is accurate at the default step; Euler and Heun are for comparisons.
simulate.durationHint: 0 = until the end of the maneuver
simulate.timing: {{sim}} s simulated in {{wall}} s ({{rtf}}× real time)

predict.title: Prediction
predict.subtitle: Motion prediction of an object list with physical motion models.
predict.modelTip: Constant velocity: straight line. Constant acceleration: speed changes, stops at standstill. CTRV: constant speed on a circle with the current yaw rate.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.subtitle: Parameters and linear single-track analysis of the vehicle presets.
vehicles.linearTip: Steady-state gains, natural frequency and damping of the lateral and yaw dynamics at constant speed.

models.title: Neural models
models.subtitle: Train a neural surrogate of the vehicle dynamics on data from a physics model, or connect your own model. Every model can drive a simulation.
models.externalInfo: External model: no training metrics. Use the closed-loop comparison below to validate it.

evaluate.title: Closed-loop validation
evaluate.text: Runs the same maneuver with the same controllers twice: with the physics teacher and with the neural model.

trainForm.title: Train a surrogate
trainForm.text: The network learns the accelerations of a physics model from Monte Carlo samples of the driving envelope.
trainForm.teacherTip: The model whose exact derivatives provide the training data.
trainForm.samplesTip: More samples improve accuracy; 20 000 take a few seconds.
trainForm.hiddenHint: Neurons per layer, comma separated, e.g. 64, 64
trainForm.name: Name

how.title: How the surrogate works
how.text: The planar kinematics stay exact; only the accelerations come from the network. The model is then a drop-in replacement of the vehicle model in every simulation.
how.validation: After training, the test-set R² and RMSE per output are shown, and a closed-loop comparison checks the error that matters for planning.

connect.title: Connect a model
connect.text: Use a model trained in PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX: as an ONNX file, or as an HTTP service.
connect.fileHint: Up to 20 MB. The server needs onnxruntime.
connect.urlHint: The operator must allow the host (MOTIONENGINE_ALLOWED_MODEL_HOSTS).
connect.contractText: The model receives the vehicle state and the inputs and returns the accelerations, in SI units.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Connection to the MotionEngine service and appearance.

api.title: API connection
api.urlHint: Empty = same server as this web app.
api.keyHint: Only needed when the server sets MOTIONENGINE_API_KEY. Stored in this browser.

settings.languageHint: Without a choice, the browser language is used; English otherwise.

design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: Tokens and components of the MotionEngine UI. Full specification in docs/design-system.md.
design.tooltip: Tooltips explain a field in one sentence.
design.expertText: Advanced settings stay hidden until needed.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.subtitle: Describe what you want to simulate or plan. The assistant runs it with MotionEngine and explains the result with the numbers behind it.
chat.placeholder: For example: double lane change at 100 km/h on wet road with the sports car
chat.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Answers come from {{model}} and the MotionEngine tools.

empty.title: Ask in plain words
empty.text: The assistant picks the vehicle, model and maneuver, runs the simulation or the planner and shows the results here. Try one of these:

suggestions.dlc: Simulate an ISO double lane change at 100 km/h with the sports car
suggestions.friction: How does a wet road (µ = 0.5) change the double lane change at 80 km/h?
suggestions.models: Compare the kinematic, nonlinear single-track and double-track models on the slalom
suggestions.plan: Plan an overtaking maneuver at 25 m/s with a car driving 15 m/s 40 m ahead

unavailable.title: The assistant is not set up
unavailable.credential: The server needs an Anthropic API key: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the MotionEngine service and restart it.
unavailable.package: The server needs the optional chat package: pip install "motion-engine[chat]", then set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and restart.

errors.not_configured: The Anthropic API key is missing or invalid.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests to the language model. Try again in a moment.
errors.api_error: The language model returned an error.
errors.network: The server cannot reach the language model.
errors.too_long: This conversation is too long. Start a new chat.
errors.invalid_tool_input: The assistant sent invalid tool input several times.
errors.other: The assistant could not finish this answer.
